name: Kota Kinabalu
registryBasis: Sabah Lands and Surveys Department lists its Land Registry Section in Kota Kinabalu. Its public services distinguish purchasable land-survey products and title/property search certificates from JTUWMA Pro, a registered-user system for detailed geometric cadastral information. DBKK separately offers local property assessment services. These establish city-local registry/cadastre and municipal assessment services, but no anonymous parcel-vector schema was found; no login, purchase, title search, lot number, or assessment lookup was used.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
technicalBlocker: The official department identifies the detailed cadastral map system as registered-user access; other public routes are product purchase or title/property search. No public anonymous geometry-only endpoint or safe field allowlist was found. No credentials, purchase, owner, address, title, parcel, or property-assessment query was made.
scopeLimits: Official public-page/document discovery only. No owner, address, tax, personal-identity, credential, account, title, cadastral-number, CPF, or property-specific lookup was submitted or retained. No full parcel geometry was retained. The supplied WUP point is not treated as a legal boundary.
remainingUncertainty: Whether Sabah JTU offers a separately documented open geometry-only layer for Kota Kinabalu; scope of any product downloads and exact geometry coverage at the WUP point.
nextStep: Use only an officially documented anonymous parcel geometry endpoint with published safe fields; do not use registered-user, purchase, title-search, or assessment flows.

officialSources.observation: The Sabah Lands and Surveys Department describes E-Commerce as a public route to purchase land-survey products and JTUWMA Pro as a registered-user system for access to detailed geometric cadastral-related information. The page does not describe anonymous access to full parcel polygons.
The department organization page identifies the Land Registry Section and places it in Kota Kinabalu District, at Wisma Tanah dan Ukur.
Sabah’s LaDESS portal states that applications for title and property search certificates are made through the JTU e-Commerce system. No title or property search was submitted.
Kota Kinabalu City Hall’s official e-services page lists local property rates/assessment, quick payment, and payment-status services; this is a local municipal record service, not parcel geometry.
